output.action: He leaves the shed, walks to the hardware store, buys a new handsaw, then goes to the footbridge to replace the step, skipping his usual coffee.
output.explanation: He has skipped coffee on tight Fridays to keep both the repair and the work call, and he has delayed repairs when a clean cut required the right tool. The bent hacksaw is too imprecise for the oak step, so he buys a handsaw instead.
